content: The interaction between posaconazole and various drugs involves complex mechanisms, primarily mediated by the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism and P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. 1. Posaconazole and Fentanyl: Posaconazole increases fentanyl levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This can lead to enhanced sedation and respiratory depression. If co-administration is necessary, monitor patients closely for these effects and adjust fentanyl doses as needed until stable drug effects are achieved. 2. Posaconazole and Fesoterodine: Posaconazole increases fesoterodine levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 3. Posaconazole and Fexinidazole: Posaconazole decreases fexinidazole levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, monitor for reduced efficacy due to decreased plasma concentrations of active metabolites M1 and M2. 4. Posaconazole and Finasteride: Posaconazole increases finasteride levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 5. Posaconazole and Finerenone: Posaconazole increases finerenone levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 6. Posaconazole and Fingolimod: Both drugs increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 7. Posaconazole and Flecainide: Both drugs increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 8. Posaconazole and Flibanserin: Posaconazole increases flibanserin levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of severe hypotension or syncope. 9. Posaconazole and Fluconazole: Both drugs increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 10. Posaconazole and Fludrocortisone: Posaconazole increases fludrocortisone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 11. Posaconazole and Flunisolide (Inhaled): Posaconazole increases flunisolide levels or effects by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 12. Posaconazole and Fluoxetine: Both drugs increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 13. Posaconazole and Fluphenazine: Both drugs increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 14. Posaconazole and Flurazepam: Posaconazole increases flurazepam levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 15. Posaconazole and Flutamide: Posaconazole increases flutamide levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Posaconazole and Fluticasone Furoate: Posaconazole increases fluticasone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor for systemic corticosteroid adverse effects, including Cushing-type symptoms. 17. Posaconazole and Fluticasone (Inhaled): Posaconazole increases fluticasone levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 18. Posaconazole and Fluvoxamine: Both drugs increase the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. 19. Posaconazole and Food: Food increases posaconazole levels by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral form of posaconazole. Co-administration with a high-fat meal is recommended. 20. Posaconazole and Formoterol: Both drugs increase the QTc interval. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 21. Posaconazole and Fosamprenavir: Fosamprenavir decreases posaconazole levels by an unknown mechanism. Modify therapy and monitor closely for breakthrough fungal infections. 22. Posaconazole and Fosaprepitant: Posaconazole increases fosaprepitant levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 23. Posaconazole and Fosphenytoin: Fosphenytoin decreases posaconazole levels by increasing metabolism via P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. 25. Posaconazole and Fostamatinib: Posaconazole increases fostamatinib levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely for toxicities that may require dose reduction. 26. Posaconazole and Futibatinib: Posaconazole increases futibatinib levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. 27. Posaconazole and Ganaxolone: Posaconazole may affect ganaxolone levels via CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 28. Posaconazole and Gefitinib: Posaconazole increases gefitinib levels or effects via CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely for adverse effects. 29.
